SearchAliases: to make a dead snake come alive
Senses.Explanation: The dead-snake image praises or challenges the capacity to make what appears lifeless come alive; each verse or comment identifies the case figure credited with that reversal. The image is a predicate in a case comment, not a report about handling an animal.
